api.VALIDATION_ERROR: Something in the request wasn't right.
api.UNAUTHORIZED: You need to sign in for that.
api.FORBIDDEN: You don't have permission for that.
api.CONFLICT: That conflicts with something that already exists.
api.RATE_LIMITED: Too many tries — wait a moment.
api.PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE: That file or request was too large.
api.INTERNAL: Something went wrong on our side.
api.INVALID_CREDENTIALS: That email and password don't match.
api.EMAIL_IN_USE: There's already an account with that email.
api.EMAIL_NOT_CONFIRMED: Confirm your email first — check your inbox.
api.ALREADY_VERIFIED: This account is already a verified Tutor.
api.DOCUMENT_UNREADABLE: We couldn't read that photo — try a sharper, well-lit one.
api.USERNAME_TAKEN: That @username is taken — try another one.
api.LESSON_LOCKED: This lesson isn't unlocked yet — finish the ones before it first.
api.ATTEMPTS_EXHAUSTED: No attempts left for this question.
api.UNSUPPORTED_SEGMENT: This part of the lesson can't be graded right now.
api.GAME_LOCKED: This game isn't unlocked yet — finish a lesson from its topic first.
api.RESULT_REJECTED: We couldn't confirm that game result, so no XP was awarded.
api.PULSE_UNCONFIGURED: Analytics isn't configured on this deployment.
api.ROLE_REJECTED: The database rejected that role change (role invariants).
